qualification: Pre-fix trex, tfhd, and tfdt parsers did not check that the box payload ended at the last declared field: trex ignored bytes beyond 24, tfhd failed to advance at += 4 on 0x00_0020 and omitted an at == header.len() check, and tfdt ignored trailing bytes beyond 8 (v0) or 12 (v1). Pre-fix baseline passed 3/3 controls and both forced acceptance gates failed because all 5 overlong boxes indexed and reached native VP9 playback.

Enforcing exact payload sizes for trex (24 bytes), tfhd (exact match with flag-selected fields), and tfdt (8 bytes for v0, 12 bytes for v1) refuses all 5 malformed cases as Error::Invalid before publishing samples or admitting native decoders.

All 4 healthy controls (regular MP4, tfhd sync override over trex non-sync, tfhd non-sync override over trex sync with lead sync, and 64-bit tfdt v1 exact header) retain exact coded packets, sync flags, 50 Hz clocks, sample/packet budgets, analytic 16x16 VP9 planes/RGB (128/130), 32 total public clamped seek targets, rewind, and repeated EOF.
4 focused tests, 66 related MP4/HLS/VP9 integration tests, 17 MP4 unit tests, 31 minimal-configuration (--no-default-features) tests, offline fixture generator unittest, and full player build pass.

ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015, 8.8.3, 8.8.7, and 8.8.12 specify fixed/flag-conditioned FullBox layouts for trex, tfhd, and tfdt. All fixtures are pure synthetic offline VP9/fMP4 files requiring neither FFmpeg nor network access.
counting: One fragmented MP4 trex/tfhd/tfdt box-extent validation fix (FVID-0181). No extra IDs for individual box variants, controls, or fixture generator.
